summary: An endpoint is a Python function with an address. You run a FastAPI app, call GET /health and POST /api/chat from the free docs page, break it on purpose to read a 404, a 405 and a 422, and add a path parameter yourself.
goal: Run a FastAPI app and call GET /health and POST /api/chat from the docs page.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: add fastapi and uvicorn, run the app, and call /health and POST /api/chat from /docs
Step 2: add a version to /health, predict what you see, then restart and check
Step 3: cause a 422, a 405 and a 404 on purpose and read each message
Step 4: add GET /api/greet/{name} and test it with your name
Play the Request Detective game to the end and see your score
